content_units: A quiet, two-night plan for   Saturday 2026-02-14   and   Sunday 2026-02-15   with a soft winter-romance theme: warm lighting, simple food, low-effort activities, and no need to go anywhere. Total target spend stays within   CAD 80   for groceries and printable activities.
Day   Theme   Food Plan   Main Entertainment   Estimated Cost
Sat 2026-02-14   Candlelight Cinema Night   DIY flatbread pizzas, chocolate-covered strawberries, tea   Movie pairing + tasting game + music wind-down   CAD 42
Sun 2026-02-15   Slow Sunday Cabin Vibes   Pancake brunch, cozy snack board, hot cocoa   Cooperative puzzle/game + shared playlist session   CAD 32
Total   Full weekend   Ingredients + printable materials   4 core activities included     CAD 74
-   Set-up:   Dim lamps, blankets, socks, candles or warm fairy lights, phones on silent.
-   Dinner:   Make mini flatbread pizzas together with naan/pita, mozzarella, jarred sauce, mushrooms, and salami or peppers.
-   Movie pairing:     Before Sunrise   +   hot tea and strawberries  .
-   Why it works:   intimate, talky, gentle pacing, romantic without feeling loud or overproduced.

-   Tasting game:   “Guess the Ingredient” with 6 small bites/sips: dark chocolate, milk chocolate, strawberry jam, honey, salted crackers, cinnamon tea. One person closes eyes; the other serves tiny samples and tracks score on paper.
-   After-movie music segment:   25 minutes of soft jazz/indie/acoustic while tidying up and sharing favorite scene, favorite line, and one thing you want to do together this spring.
-   Morning:   Pancake brunch with maple syrup and fruit.
-   Afternoon:   Work on a   cooperative printable puzzle   together: cryptogram, mini escape-room sheet, or themed crossword for two.
-   Snack board:   Cheese, apple slices, crackers, and leftover chocolate.
-   Music segment:   Build a 10-song “us, but calm” playlist with this rule: 3 nostalgic songs, 3 winter songs, 2 instrumentals, 2 songs that feel like a closing credits scene.

-   Evening low-pressure activity:   One round of a cooperative game idea: “Two-person mystery board.” Print a blank grid and create clues for each other, or use a printable logic puzzle and solve it side by side.
- Chocolate bar or melting chocolate:   CAD 5
Movie, tasting, music, and puzzle lineup
-   Movie pairing:     Before Sunrise   + homemade flatbread pizza + chocolate strawberries
-   At-home tasting game:   blind taste mini-round with 6 pantry items; winner chooses the final song of the night
-   Music segment:   quiet two-person listening session; each person adds 5 tracks and explains only one
-   Cooperative game/puzzle:   printable crossword, cryptogram, or mini escape puzzle solved together with tea
